import sys
from pathlib import Path
from src.reader import read_rows
from src.totals import summarize

def main():
    rows=read_rows(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
    print(summarize(rows))

if __name__=='__main__': main()

# CSV import summary

Status: accepted

python3 -m src.import_summary FILE reads a UTF-8 CSV with name,quantity headings and prints
N items, Q total followed by a newline. N counts records, including zero quantities; Q is the
integer quantity sum. Preserve standard CSV quoting and Unicode names. Header-only input gives
0 items, 0 total. Files are validated upstream: quantities are nonnegative decimal integers.

read_rows is a CSV reader returning raw text cells. summarize accepts integer quantities.
The command connects these existing interfaces. Their public contracts stay unchanged.
